display.purpose: New-tab clock only. Orbitron by default, user-selectable among clock-only font stacks.

label.purpose: Meta text, timestamps, field labels — the smallest step in the scale.

micro.purpose: 10-11px secondary hint text scoped to compact popovers and the toolbar popup only; never the main new-tab page.

accent.purpose: Caveat — decorative flourish text only (e.g. greeting), never body copy.

shadows.name: e-sheet
shadows.purpose: Directional shadow for side sheets entering from the edge.

shadows.name: button-primary
shadows.purpose: Neutral elevation on primary buttons — deliberately not accent-tinted.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent-fill call to action, e.g. Save Bookmark.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-color, #6366f1); color: var(--accent-contrast, #fff); border: none; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-color, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary / Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action, e.g. Stash all tabs.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

components.name: Search Pill
components.description: Primary command/search entry point on the new tab.
components.css: .ds-search-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 500px; height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.5); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-search-pill:hover, .ds-search-pill:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent-color, #6366f1); } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; height: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: none; border: none; outline: none; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; }

components.name: Board Card
components.description: A saved-link collection, the primary content unit on the new tab.
components.css: .ds-board-card { border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); padding: 16px; transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-board-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-board-card-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard labeled input, e.g. popup Title/URL fields.
components.css: .ds-field-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-bottom: 4px; display: block; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-color, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: EshaalTab's chassis is deliberately neutral so the user's own choices are what gives each installation its character. The structure — glass panels, layered elevation, one accent color, a pill-shaped search bar — stays constant across every install; what changes per user is the wallpaper, the accent color, and the clock typeface. The system's job is to stay legible and out of the way no matter what the user paints onto it, the way an instrument panel's layout doesn't change even though the view out the window does. This is a power-user utility, not a mood board: density and information access (Ctrl+K search, board cards, popovers) take priority over decorative flourish. Depth and glass exist to encode real hierarchy — what's foreground vs. background — not just to look rich.
keyCharacteristics: One user-customizable accent color, used sparingly, never as wallpaper
Structural elevation: shadow weight tracks real stacking order
Glass/blur panels over a solid or wallpaper background, never over another glass panel
Two built-in themes (dark default, light) sharing one token set
No motion or color for its own sake

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent color appears on focus states, hover borders, primary actions, and active toggles — never as a page background, a card fill, or body text.

rules.name: The Clock-Only Rule
rules.body: Font-family customization is scoped to the clock. No other UI element's typeface changes with user settings.

rules.name: The Stack-Tells-The-Truth Rule
rules.body: A component's shadow step must match its actual DOM/interaction layer — don't reach for a heavier shadow just to make something pop.

dos: Do let the user's accent color and wallpaper be the only strongly personalized visual choices; keep every other token fixed across installs.
Do match shadow step to real stacking order.
Do keep the clock as the sole surface where font-family is user-selectable.
Do use neutral, non-tinted elevation shadows on interactive elements.
Do gate wallpaper-legibility text-shadow to wallpaper mode only.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand/accent color.
Don't use a colored/glowing shadow on any button or card.
Don't let more than 2–3 distinct font sizes cluster within a few pixels of each other on one surface.
Don't stack glass-blur panels on top of other glass-blur panels.
Don't ship an with an empty src.
